reason: I'd take the free call and look at the 15 companies, since that costs me nothing, but I'm not putting EUR 1,500 down this month. The last agency also sent nice slides before they took my money, and the new country is a next-year plan anyway.
objection: I paid an agency before and got nothing. A logistics company getting 45 meetings tells me nothing about whether distributors in my target country will take a meeting with a Bulgarian wholesaler, and 'qualified meeting' can be stretched to mean anyone who picks up.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies are ones I'd actually want to sell to, and a past client who is a wholesaler or distributor tells me on the phone that the meetings turned into real orders.
